# Abstract {.unnumbered}

This document is the algorithmic specification for Cortext, a local
multimodal memory engine with no language model on its write or read path. It
is a technical reference for implementation. It covers online boundary
segmentation, multi-granularity hybrid retrieval with late-interaction
reranking, hydration and evidence fitting, the Focus (F), Sensitivity (S)
and Stability (T) macro-control surface, and the record of mechanisms removed
by long-horizon ablation.
